name: Awesome Black Friday / Cyber Monday (trungdq88)
accepts: 'Only software, apps, or SaaS. No courses, books, boilerplates, etc.' Many categories, including a section for mobile apps. Not accepted: books, courses, boilerplates, templates, starter kits, themes, plugins.
how_to_submit: Pull request adding one row at the end of the matching category table in README.md. The call for the year is posted as an issue (2026: issue 2352); the rules live in issue 367. No CONTRIBUTING file, no pull request template.
entry_format: | emoji | [Name](url) | Description. | 40% OFF all lifetime licenses with code **BF2026** (Nov 2 - Dec 1) |  (bold discount, bold code or 'no code needed', dates in parentheses)
rules: One entry per product. Do not create new categories (use MISC) and do not spread one product across categories.

Written rule (issue 367): 'If you have more than 2 deals/apps that are closely related to each other, please submit them as a single entry, not multiple ones.' The list's bot enforces it as a cap of two apps per maker, citing the same issue. Plan for at most two rows per maker.
The product page must show the specific discount, the dates and the amount or percentage; deals without a clear before and after price, or with hidden pricing, are not accepted.

Banned: 100% off or free-while-in-beta deals, price-increase-soon offers, pre-orders and waitlists, shortened links, links to other deals or bundles, like/comment/subscribe gates, bundles priced against the sum of separate products.

Bot closings in November 2026 also turned away AI tools sold as credits, API resellers, launch prices presented as discounts, and products that are not 'established'; none of these is in the written rules.
The pull request may contain only the relevant diff. First come, first merged. The maintainer picks a small number of deals for a newsletter.
status_note: 357 pull requests from outside authors merged since 1 Oct 2026, the latest on 20 Nov 2026; 65 open.
recommended_for: software, apps and SaaS; mobile apps have their own section; at most two rows per maker
